name: dead-wave
description: Dead-Wave — a browser survival game. Native ES modules, no build step.
comment: No dependencies, on purpose. The game runs straight from this folder with no build
step (AGENTS.md rule 12), and the tools drive Chrome over the DevTools Protocol using
Node's built-in WebSocket, so a clean clone can run npm test with nothing installed
and no network. Node 22 or newer.
